name: WERK IDEENWERK impact-review feedback contract
purpose: Expose current, source-bound impact-review and improvement hypotheses as bounded optional context for the existing AI synthesis path, without promoting observation, attribution or improvement hypotheses to facts, causal effects, recommendations or political decisions.

consumption.matching_rule: A review is eligible only when its measurement plan impact_map_id and reform_id occur in the submission's current Impact Bridge candidate mapping and its full map/reform/artifact/source-version tuple still passes the authoritative validator.
consumption.stale_behavior: Any otherwise relevant review with stale authoritative source binding makes the feedback context revalidation_required; no stale feedback items are exposed.
consumption.snapshot_rule: Current impact_review IDs are included in the AI synthesis source snapshot. A newly eligible review or stale feedback state changes the snapshot hash and invalidates older variants as current.

epistemic_boundaries: observed KPI movement is not causal policy impact
alternative explanations and uncertainties remain visible
feedback is optional context and never an automatic policy change
no political ranking, recommendation, acceptance or rejection is introduced
no new fiscal or numeric effect is manufactured

ai_integration.rule: The existing provider remains disabled by default. This integration only defines source-bound context and validation; it does not perform a paid or external model call.

negative_guards: stale Impact Bridge makes feedback unavailable for current synthesis
reviews without improvement hypothesis are excluded
reviews without explicit uncertainty are excluded
reviews without provenance source_refs are excluded
review refs not present in the current source snapshot fail AI synthesis persistence
new review refs invalidate earlier source snapshots as current
feedback cannot bypass existing anti-ranking, anti-decision and anti-new-numeric-effect guards
acceptance_boundary: Builder implementation and reversible Staging evidence may prove only the bounded feedback-consumption contract. COUNTERCHECKED/ACCEPTED/Production status requires independent evidence according to WERK governance.
